{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Changli |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Ah, look who we have here. A rare visitor. Luckily, I've finished my work for today. Would you like to join me in a game of Weiqi, if you're not in a rush to leave? |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = I seem to know a lot about your past, you say? *a small chuckle* Not really. I'd say you may have left those clues for your present self long ago, and I just happened to come across them while going through historical records. I am honored to guide you through the connections between your past and present. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = A strategist's mind is a vast and complex entity, much like the ocean. Its placid exterior may mask the turbulent currents of thought swirling within. Master once warned me to be wary of those who stay quiet in times of uncertainty. Yet with you, I find solace in the quiet moments, in our unspoken connection. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Master Xuanmiao taught me the ways of the sword, but he left this world before I could fully absorb his teachings. I have since tried my best to understand his notes and continue my training on my own. When I first saw you wield your sword, it struck a chord with me, and now I understand why. It's not that you resemble my late master in your skills, but rather that he learned from you. |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = I found you and brought you out of that Sonoro Sphere. This is proof I am qualified to stand by your side and assist in achieving our shared goal. It takes great courage and wisdom to willingly enter into a situation full of unknowns, and I trust that you will achieve your desired outcome. My knowledge and power are at your disposal, always ready to help you in any way needed. |vo_02_01_title = Changli's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = The dynamics of a Weiqi game mirror the complexities of our world, always in a state of constant flux and transformation... Fascinating, isn't it? |vo_02_02_title = Changli's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = My body temperature is higher than usual because of my Flame-controlling Forte. It doesn't hinder daily tasks, but it does have its quirky consequences. Jinhsi's iced pastries and Sanhua's delicate snow birds always melt faster than I'd prefer in my hands... Sigh. |vo_02_02_mention = Jinhsi, Sanhua |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Each delicacy is unique in its own right. It's difficult to choose just one, but if I must, there was a meal I received as a hungry child, a kind gesture that left an indelible memory. That taste remains with me to this day. |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = What food do I dislike? It's not something that crosses my mind often.
Having traveled through barren lands where people suffer from starvation, I have learned to appreciate every bit of nourishment.
Plus, there are endless culinary delights beyond the borders of {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}}.
Even if I spent years exploring, I doubt I could taste them all. |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = I have always dreamed of a world filled with peace and prosperity. Though I may not live to see it myself, I will do everything in my power to support those who continue to work towards that future. And when that day finally arrives, if you ever find yourself back in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}, please take a moment to leave a cup of tea for me at my resting place. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = The feather I gave you before? Well, it was forged from the fires of my heart. There are only two of them.
As long as you hold onto that feather, my fire will never harm you. In fact, I can use it to track your whereabouts if you wish. However, if it ever falls into our enemies' hands... hehe. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = Why did I quit my job in the capital and request a transfer to {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}? It's quite simple, really. After the Battle Beneath the Crescent, there was no {{Extra Effect|Magistrate|Magistrate|The Magistrate is a governing official who oversees one of the major regions within Huanglong.}} in Jinzhou and the central government couldn't just sit by and let chaos reign. Also, my master had a strong connection to Mt. Firmament. He told me it would be the very place where I would find the one I needed to look for. I didn't quite understand his intentions then, but now... well, as they say, fate works in mysterious ways. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Jinhsi]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Jinhsi.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = Jinhsi is a bright and diligent soul. With time, she will undoubtedly blossom into a capable {{Extra Effect|Magistrate}}. She has always been dedicated to her work, perhaps too much so. She simply needs some time to find balance and fully embrace who she truly is. I am entrusting her care to you, Rover. |vo_04_01_mention = Jinhsi |vo_04_02_title = About [[Jiyan]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Jiyan.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = Upon my initial arrival in {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}, I was tasked with handling paperwork at the City Hall for a temporary period. Despite sifting through countless documents and files, never once did I come across any issues regarding our border defenses. During the time when Jinzhou was lacking a {{Extra Effect|Magistrate}}, General Jiyan's unwavering efforts were essential in protecting the welfare of our people. |vo_04_02_mention = Jiyan |vo_04_03_title = About [[Sanhua]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Sanhua.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Sanhua is always composed and silent. As a bodyguard, she remains vigilant and alert at all times. But both Jinhsi and I have always wished for her to take a well-deserved rest and let others help shoulder the burden. |vo_04_03_mention = Sanhua, Jinhsi |vo_04_04_title = About [[Jianxin]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Jianxin.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Although we followed different sects of Taoist teachings, I found commonalities with her. Her pure and open mind is quite rare nowadays. I believe her perception of the world must be as clear as her eyes. I first met her at the tea house; back then, she seemed to have sensed something about my condition, and served me a bowl of Lotus Seed Soup. That was a delightful surprise. |vo_04_04_mention = Jianxin |vo_04_05_title = About [[Chixia]] |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Chixia.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = Chixia is a vibrant girl, radiating warmth and enthusiasm like a shining flame. She graciously showed me around {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}, introducing me to all the local gems and delectable delicacies. Ah, yes, now I remember... The Spicy Pulled Chicken may seem intimidating to many, but it's just the right amount of spice for me. |vo_04_05_mention = Chixia |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = Happy birthday, my dear. When I was younger, I traveled to many places and saw diverse customs for celebrating birthdays, each one unique and fascinating. Here are some gift boxes for you, a small token of my affection. May you find peace and happiness in the years ahead, like the constant moon and rising sun. Oh, these may be too much? Hehe… Consider them extra gifts for your future birthdays. And if I'm still around to see them, I'll find you something different. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = (Hmm...) |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = (Contemplating) |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = The moment at hand... This very moment is the best of our lives. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = I am Changli, Counselor to the Jinzhou {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou}}. Pleased to make your acquaintance, Rover. We meet at last. Should you ever need any assistance in Jinzhou, please let me know. |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = Eons of time on this vast land, all encapsulated in a humble game...
I am fortunate to have you as my opponent. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Time to start a new game. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Plan with convention, then conquer by ingenuity. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = Who will be sitting on the other side of the board this time? |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = The sword has no set form, it adapts along with its foes... Likewise, strategies must shift against different opponents. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = Oh? This feeling of power coursing through my veins... It feels different from before. Please, do spar with me for another round. |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = After my master's passing, I spent years studying martial arts and other subjects through… various unconventional methods. This resulted in some rather comical situations, where angry bookshop owners chased me around. But now, I have the luxury of having you teach me everything without any expectations in return. It's something my younger self could only dream of. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = I never thought I could further refine my abilities. Your guidance has been invaluable, and I ought to help you in some way in return. So… Anything I can do for you? |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = You've taught me more than words can express... I believed I had come to terms with my death; never thought I could one day catch a glimpse into the perspective of an eternal being. For this, I am grateful. As long as my flames still burn, I will stay by your side, dear Rover. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Changli |language = en |basic_1_tx = Clear as the blaze. |basic_2_tx = My blade yearns. |basic_3_tx = Mind's eye. |aerial_1_tx = Burn! |resskill_1_tx = Perish in flames. |resskill_2_tx = Feathers incinerate. |resskill_3_tx = Crosscut, sever. |resliberation_1_tx = Be reduced to cinders. |resliberation_2_tx = Beckon the divine flames. |resliberation_3_tx = Who is the caged bird now? |resliberation_4_tx = Break! |resliberation_5_tx = Sever. |dodge_1_tx = Think fast. |counter_1_tx = From defense to offense. |hit_1_tx = Now that's a hassle. |hit_2_tx = Silly mistake... |hit_3_tx = I am fine. |injured_1_tx = Triumph through sacrifice. |injured_2_tx = No need to dwell on it. |fallen_1_tx = The cycle of life... |fallen_2_tx = One... wrong move... |fallen_3_tx = A necessary sacrifice... |esummon_1_tx = Reveal yourself. |etransform_1_tx = Take form. |introoutro_1_tx = Together we vanquish. |introoutro_2_tx = Strike! |enemynear_1_tx = Guests of the unkind. |glider_1_tx = Winds, heed my command. |grapple_1_tx = (Effort Sound) |sensor_1_tx = *light chuckle*...
